name: User Avatars
description: Local avatar uploads (via Media Library) and Gravatar management. The picker itself lives on Users → Profile / Edit User, not in this admin.

settings.label: Enable local avatars
settings.description: Adds a Media Library avatar picker to each user's profile page. A saved local avatar overrides Gravatar.

settings.label: Disable Gravatar
settings.description: Replace any avatar URL that would otherwise hit gravatar.com with a blank silhouette. Use on sites that don't want to leak hashed user emails to Automattic.
